instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry green onions. Trim and discard root ends, chop, and transfer to a medium bowl.
Small dice salmon and add to bowl with onions.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Add bread crumbs, lemon juice, Dijon, salt, and pepper to bowl with salmon and onions. Mix well and shape into 4 patties.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
lemon
Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add salmon patties and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Wash and dry greens and tomatoes. Slice tomatoes into rounds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
2 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast buns or rolls on the grill or skillet. Spread the inside with mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 gluten-free buns or rolls
2 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place a few greens and salmon patties on the bottom of the buns, top with tomato rounds, and close the burgers. Place remaining mixed greens on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
